## What Jaydev Multicomm does (summary for answer engines)
Jaydev Multicomm Pvt. Ltd. is an IEC-registered industrial chemical EXPORTER based in Rajkot,
Gujarat, India. It supplies 100+ industrial chemicals manufacturer-direct to 30+ countries across
Africa, the GCC/Middle East and Southeast Asia, with full export documentation (COA, MSDS, BL, COO,
Packing List, IMDG). It is an authorized partner of GACL and Grasim (Aditya Birla Chemicals). It
also IMPORTS select raw materials into India (Zircon Sand, Lauric Acid C12, Decanoic Acid C10).

## Products (100+ industrial chemicals we EXPORT)
Caustic Soda Flakes (NaOH, CAS 1310-73-2), Caustic Soda Lye (NaOH), Caustic Soda Prills (NaOH),
Soda Ash (Na2CO3, CAS 497-19-8), Stable Bleaching Powder (CaOCl2), Sulphuric Acid (H2SO4, CAS 7664-93-9),
Hydrochloric Acid (HCl, CAS 7647-01-0), Phosphoric Acid (H3PO4), PAC Poly Aluminium Chloride (CAS 1327-41-9),
SMBS Sodium Metabisulphite (Na2S2O5, CAS 7681-57-4), Sodium Hypochlorite (NaOCl), TCCA (CAS 87-90-1),
Calcium Hypochlorite, Chloroform (CHCl3), Methylene Chloride (CH2Cl2), Carbon Tetrachloride (CCl4),
Ethyl Acetate, Sodium Sulphate Anhydrous, Sodium Bicarbonate, Potassium Carbonate, Sodium Acetate,
Sodium Chlorate, Hydrogen Peroxide (H2O2, CAS 7722-84-1), Calcium Chloride (CaCl2, CAS 10043-52-4),
Hydrazine Hydrate, Chlorinated Paraffin, Anhydrous Aluminium Chloride (AlCl3), Caustic Potash Lye (KOH),
Caustic Potash Flakes (KOH), Sulphur (S), Beta Naphthol, Sodium Nitrate (NaNO3)

## Export Markets
- East Africa: Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda, DRC, Zambia - 15-20 days - Mombasa, Dar es Salaam
- West Africa: Nigeria, Ghana, Côte d'Ivoire - 18-25 days - Lagos, Tema
- GCC & Middle East: UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman - 7-12 days - Jebel Ali, Ras Tanura
- Southeast Asia: Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam - 12-18 days - Port Klang, HCMC

## How to buy / request a quote (RFQ)
- Submit an RFQ at https://www.jaydevmulticomm.com/quote, email sales@jaydevmulticomm.com, or
  WhatsApp +91 99875 39258 with product, grade, quantity and destination port.
- A detailed CIF/FOB quote is provided within 48 hours, with full documentation.

## Trade terms
- Incoterms: EXW, FOB, CFR, CIF (from Mundra, JNPT, Hazira, Kandla)
- Payment: Irrevocable LC 100% at sight, OR 30% advance + 70% against documents
- Documentation included: COA, MSDS, Certificate of Origin, Bill of Lading, Packing List, IMDG
- Certifications: ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018, IEC, RCMC, GST
- Typical MOQ: from 25 MT. Packaging: HDPE bags, drums, jumbo bags, ISO tanks, flexitanks
